The built-in desk and shelving unit feature a contemporary design with a green and beige color scheme, reflecting a blend of traditional and modern aesthetics. The space is well-lit with natural light from the left and ambient lighting from the right, emphasizing the clean, smooth surfaces and glossy finishes of the materials used.
